items.title: `KeySlots::identity` mints from `fresh_id()`, whose counter overlaps `Shared::identity`'s (and so `SignalCell::identity`'s): a tracked body that reads a cell and a map entry with equal numbers dedups them and the entry's edge is never attached (`collide.vl`: `sealed=4, want 103`)
items.body: Fix in store-45 before its merge: ONE std minting function for identity numbers, used by `KeySlots`, the entries/memos and the store's `identity_at`; every `fresh_id()` use classified. Pin both shapes.

items.title: native: `fired.write() += 1` in an effect run from a turn drain (a `batch`) aborts "a cell was read while it is being updated"; the same line works inline, and `fired.write() = fired.read() + 1` works in the drain
items.body: Repro `nat5.vl`. F62's scoped borrow for a compound assignment through `write()` under a drain. Sizing S–M; native lane, Order 46 FIRST (a runtime abort).

items.title: a trait's methods resolve in user code with NO import once any LOADED std module imports the trait: `import std::markdown;` makes `42.to_string()` compile without importing `Display`
items.body: Repro `disp2.vl`. It made a wasm steer test depend on which std modules a layer loads. B318's rule says a trait method needs its trait in scope. Sizing M; solver.

items.title: an annotated `let lend: \|(\|&i32\| void)\| void = \|f\| ..` does not type `f`: "f is never given a type"
items.body: Repro `closureview.vl`. B513's and F77's family (a closure literal's parameters from the position's closure type). Sizing S–M.
